<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Test_Level__c</fullName>
    <description>Org to org: tests run when validating and deploying.</description>
    <fieldManageability>SubscriberControlled</fieldManageability>
    <label>Test Level</label>
    <required>false</required>
    <type>Picklist</type>
    <valueSet>
        <restricted>true</restricted>
        <valueSetDefinition>
            <sorted>false</sorted>
            <value>
                <fullName>NoTestRun</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>No tests (sandbox and Developer Edition only)</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>RunLocalTests</fullName>
                <default>true</default>
                <label>Local tests</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>RunAllTestsInOrg</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>All tests</label>
            </value>
        </valueSetDefinition>
    </valueSet>
</CustomField>
